events.title: Hot Toddies: Sunbleached
events.location: The Triffid Beer Garden, 7-9 Stratton St, Newstead QLD
events.source: The Triffid (presented with Wild Turkey Bourbon)
events.description: An evening of live music in the outdoor beer garden featuring Sunbleached as part of the Hot Toddies series. It offers a relaxed, casual atmosphere for enjoying local music.

events.title: HUMBE — Dueño del Cielo Tour
events.location: The Triffid, 7-9 Stratton St, Newstead QLD
events.description: Mexican singer-songwriter Humbe brings his 'Dueño del Cielo' tour to Brisbane, performing his signature pop-inflected R&B sounds. This is a ticketed concert event featuring international touring talent.

events.title: Sundowners (beer garden selectors)
events.location: The Triffid Beer Garden, 7-9 Stratton St, Newstead QLD
events.description: A recurring Friday evening event featuring various guest DJs and selectors playing music in the beer garden. It is designed as a casual social setting to transition into the weekend.

events.title: ANUV JAIN — Dastakhat World Tour
events.location: The Triffid, 7-9 Stratton St, Newstead QLD
events.description: Indian singer-songwriter Anuv Jain performs his emotive indie-pop songs as part of his Dastakhat World Tour. The event features his intimate, acoustic-driven musical style.

events.title: 4H FEST (HIP HOP HABLA HISPANA) – LA ETNNIA
events.location: The Outpost, 320 Brunswick St, Fortitude Valley QLD
events.description: A specialized hip-hop festival dedicated to Spanish-speaking artists, featuring legendary Colombian group La Etnnia. The event celebrates the international reach and cultural impact of the Hispanic hip-hop movement.
